description_en: It can detect elementary school arithmetic problems and provide judgment results. It supports basic operations (addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division) on integers, mixed integer operations, comparisons of magnitude, identification of the maximum or minimum number, and more
description_zh: 可以识别小学数学口算题目并给出题目判断结果。可支持整数的加减乘除四则运算、整数的混合运算、大小比较、最大数最小数等
kebab_example: aliyun ocr-api recognize-edu-oral-calculation --url 'https://img.alicdn.com/imgextra/i4/O1CN01diDxZe21hNSkCBf5n_!!6000000007016-0-tps-2268-3024.jpg' --biz-body '图片二进制文件' --region cn-hangzhou
name: RecognizeEduOralCalculation

parameters.help_en:
This field and the body field are mutually exclusive; you must provide one and only one.  
Image URL (must not exceed 2048 bytes; base64 is not supported).
parameters.help_zh:
本字段和body字段二选一，不可同时透传或同时为空。
图片链接（长度不超2048字节，不支持base64）
parameters.name: url

parameters.help_en:
This field and the URL field are mutually exclusive; you must provide one and only one.  
Binary file of the image, up to 10 MB.  
When invoking via HTTP, upload the binary file of the image in the HTTP body.  
When invoking via the software development kit (SDK), place the image in the SDK body.
parameters.help_zh:
本字段和URL字段二选一，不可同时透传或同时为空。
图片二进制文件，最大10MB。
使用HTTP方式调用，把图片二进制文件放到HTTP body中上传即可。
使用SDK的方式调用，把图片放到SDK的body中即可
parameters.name: body

Code.description_en: Error code (this field is not returned if detection succeeded)
Code.description_zh: 错误码（如果识别成功，不会返回此字段）

Message.description_en: Error message (this field is not returned if detection succeeded)
Message.description_zh: 错误提示（如果识别成功，不会返回此字段）
Message.example: You are not authorized to perform this operation.
